scope: Candidate features for an independently implemented instance fork. Priorities are research recommendations. No new peptide feature has been implemented by this backlog.

items.reference_capability: Due and completed doses, countdowns and one-tap logging.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: TodayMedications and GLP-1 quick log.
items.proposed_work: Keep the existing checklist. Add stock coverage and current protocol phase to each relevant card.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Reuse existing entries and adherence calculations.

items.reference_capability: Separate oral and ad-hoc forms avoid injection-only fields.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: oral medication forms and PRN entries.
items.proposed_work: Retain ordinary medication and PRN logging. Add route-specific fields only where required.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Avoid forcing non-GLP-1 medicines through injection logging.

items.reference_capability: Decimal arithmetic derives concentration and converts mg, mcg, mL and device markings.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: vial concentration and volume fields, without a dedicated preparation engine.
items.proposed_work: Add a preparation calculator with stored inputs and a server calculation shared by web and mobile.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Requires preparation records. Calculator inputs must come from the actual product instructions.
items.implementation_scope: Preparation-records tranche: persist original mass in mg/mcg, final volume, mode, date and diluent; derive mass and concentration on server/shared logic. Device-unit conversion and graduation rounding remain deferred.
items.verification: Local focused checks; isolated PostgreSQL fresh migrations, rerunnable additive migration, preparation scope/immutability/concurrency tests and medication RLS matrix. Deployment is verified separately.

items.reference_capability: Device graduation rounding exposes delivered mass, volume and rounding error.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: existing dose tracking does not model syringe graduation rounding.
items.proposed_work: Show requested mass, measured volume and resulting delivered mass as separate values.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on D03 and device configuration. Retain exact values before display rounding.
items.implementation_scope: Syringe-only parity: reusable settings/default, mg/mcg/mL/units inputs, 40-digit decimal nearest-increment half-up preview and server-calculated delivered mass/volume. Pen/pump presentation and visual-device rendering remain deferred. Account-owned devices only; source shared/global devices remain deferred.
items.verification: Shared source-parity arithmetic and focused client/server checks; isolated PostgreSQL fresh/repeated migration, device/lifecycle/edit/concurrency/audit retention tests and medication RLS. Production deployment verified separately.

items.reference_capability: Capacity and insufficient-volume blocks, plus small-draw and rounding warnings.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: inventory and dose validation exist, without the same draw checks.
items.proposed_work: Add server validation for preparation volume and device constraints using the verified source warn/block behavior.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on D03–D04. Physical constraints are not clinical dose validation.
items.implementation_scope: Exact source checks only: target above capacity/known remaining blocks; raw unit draw below 2, full-barrel target and >5% mass error warn. No already-taken override or additional clinical/stock thresholds.
items.verification: Shared source-parity arithmetic and focused client/server checks; isolated PostgreSQL fresh/repeated migration, device/lifecycle/edit/concurrency/audit retention tests and medication RLS. Production deployment verified separately.

items.reference_capability: Visual syringe markings, pen dose windows and a default device.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: pen/vial inventory exists. No equivalent calibrated syringe preview found.
items.proposed_work: Add optional device profiles and a clear visual draw preview to injection logging.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on D03–D05. A graphic must match the stored graduation settings.
items.implementation_scope: Syringe-only visual in existing Cabinet logging/editing previews, with target-volume/capacity fill, quarter ticks, existing rounded marking and optional four target-unit values. Existing default/device settings reused; pen/pump visuals remain deferred. Preview-flow follow-up: selected-device empty/pending/error figure with neutral em-dash caption, current-response numbers only, preferred-else-first untouched selection and preserved explicit manual mode. This tracks source ad-hoc behavior; scheduled source form differs. No numbered scale or design-only dashed marker is claimed. User-clarified flow: choose an available saved device automatically without a selection step; never fabricate a device when none exist. Existing dose/device/preview controls precede the body map in the same card, following source order.
items.verification: Visual base plus preview-flow follow-up verified by 75 web tests, full web static/build checks, final affected mobile calibration tests and earlier full mobile checks. Synthetic actual-App desktop/narrow/light/dark neutral/ready/rounded-zero/correction states and independent source-flow review passed. Backend/shared/schema/dependencies remain unchanged; deployment is verified separately.

items.reference_capability: Pump volume and bottle fill produce pump counts and mL, without injection sites.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: medication routes exist. No preparation-linked pump model found.
items.proposed_work: Add pump calibration, bottle volume and route-aware logging only if needed.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on preparation/device records. No assumptions about absorption equivalence.

items.reference_capability: Body map records site and supports site rotation.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: clickable map, rotation suggestions and resting-site states.
items.proposed_work: Retain Sparky’s map and its shared web/mobile site definitions.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Already substantially overlaps.

items.reference_capability: Dose edits and deletion reconcile vial volume transactionally and write audit records.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: injection deletion already refunds inventory dose counts.
items.proposed_work: Extend stock reconciliation to exact mass/volume and preserve a revision audit for changed dose records.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on I02/I05. Test retries, concurrent logs and corrections.
items.implementation_scope: Existing transactional calibrated corrections credit original use and recalculate delivered quantities; edits and deletion reconcile stock, including concurrency regression coverage. Separate dose-revision audit remains unimplemented; lifecycle status audit is not a dose audit.
items.verification: Reconciled against existing edb6c85ec repository behavior and focused real PostgreSQL correction/deletion/concurrency checks; no new accounting feature added in this slice.

items.reference_capability: IndexedDB outbox uses client UUIDs and retries; service worker caches visited pages.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: PWA/mobile foundations exist. Equivalent web medication outbox not found.
items.proposed_work: Queue dose records per account with a visible pending state, idempotency and server reconciliation.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Not a complete offline app. Handle account switching, stale stock and queue failures explicitly.

items.reference_capability: Fixed times, intervals, multiple daily slots and weekly patterns.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: daily, selected days, intervals, weekly, monthly, cyclic, taper and PRN.
items.proposed_work: Keep shared schedule logic. Reuse it for additional preparation features.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Do not introduce a competing schedule engine.

items.reference_capability: Ramp generator and phase resolution expose the current step.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing foundation: titration steps and a web titration manager.
items.proposed_work: Add a user-entered ramp builder and clearer current-phase previews with an explicit confirmation.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Plan from user/prescriber inputs. Do not auto-prescribe a ramp from a website.

items.reference_capability: A stack groups separate protocols, preparations and logging actions.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: named medication protocol groups.
items.proposed_work: Group existing medicines into a named course while retaining separate dose and stock records.
items.dependencies_and_limits: A grouped action must show component results and avoid partial or duplicate logging.

items.reference_capability: Components have their own ramps and optionally move together.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: individual titration exists, without stack coordination.
items.proposed_work: Support independent component phases after basic stack grouping works.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on P02–P03 and versioned protocols. Grouping does not establish compatibility.

items.reference_capability: A schedule rewrite completes the old protocol and creates a linked replacement, retaining course adherence.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: dose snapshots exist; schedules and titration steps can be edited in place.
items.proposed_work: Add effective-dated protocol versions and link each planned/logged dose to its version.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Preserve historical adherence and current phase across frequency changes. Broader than dose snapshots.

items.reference_capability: Active, future, paused, ended and completed courses are separated.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: active medication flags and schedule start/end dates exist.
items.proposed_work: Add explicit course lifecycle and future-start groups without changing medicine identity.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on P05. Past courses should remain queryable.

items.reference_capability: Course-level on/off weeks are separate from weekly dose rhythms and have boundary reminders.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: cyclic daily schedules exist, without the same course-level model.
items.proposed_work: Add recorded course start, planned finish and break/restart dates with user-controlled restart.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on P05–P06. Do not infer a medically appropriate cycle length.

items.reference_capability: Concurrent protocols, cycle boundaries and end dates appear together.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: dedicated medication-course Gantt view.
items.proposed_work: Add a read-first timeline of overlaps, phases and breaks, then controlled date editing.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on P05–P07. Reuse schedule data, not an independent calendar.

items.reference_capability: Suggests weekday rotations, with before/after load and first-dose transition details.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: workload-balancing suggestions.
items.proposed_work: Defer automatic suggestions. A future preview could compare only user-authorised alternative days.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Keeping weekly totals unchanged can still alter time between doses. Needs medication-specific constraints.

items.feature: Rebase schedules after a late dose
items.reference_capability: Explicit rebasing and rolling intervals can adjust upcoming planned slots.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: fixed and interval schedules exist. No equivalent interactive rebase flow found.
items.proposed_work: Offer an explicit preview of future slots affected by a user-requested schedule change.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on P05. Recording a late dose must not silently reschedule future doses.

items.reference_capability: Freezes device-local day and zone per dose. Uses a 02:00 local tracking-day boundary and home-zone reminders.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing timezone helpers and entry dates; no equivalent per-dose travel provenance found.
items.proposed_work: Preserve UTC instant plus original local day/zone. Consider an optional medication-day cutoff.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Keep nutrition days independent. Test DST and travel. Pitstop’s 02:00 rule need not become Sparky’s default.

items.reference_capability: Prescriber, pharmacy, expiry, refill counts, next refill and source documents link to vials/protocols.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: prescriber, pharmacy and prescription-number fields exist.
items.proposed_work: Add refill authorisations, refill events, expiry and links to course/inventory.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Reuse existing medication identity and permission model.

items.reference_capability: Optional wizard creates linked prescription and protocol. Off by default.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: equivalent linked wizard.
items.proposed_work: Add a guided flow once preparation, course and refill models are stable.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Pitstop feature requires ENABLE_PRESCRIPTION_WIZARD. Do not treat it as enabled by default.

items.reference_capability: Sealed, in-use, finished and discarded stock, with preparation actions.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: pen/vial records, lifecycle, dose counts, expiry and reorder flags.
items.proposed_work: Extend the existing inventory rather than create a separate peptide store.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Use existing medication_pens where sensible and add preparation relationships.
items.implementation_scope: Bounded existing inventory lifecycle: finished/discarded with finish time and source-like status audit; preserve quantities/history and permit status reopening. No spill/priming/manual-adjustment features.
items.verification: Shared source-parity arithmetic and focused client/server checks; isolated PostgreSQL fresh/repeated migration, device/lifecycle/edit/concurrency/audit retention tests and medication RLS. Production deployment verified separately.

items.reference_capability: A preparation stores mass, concentration, diluent, prepared date, remaining mL and BUD.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: vial concentration/volume and opened date are stored, without separate preparation history.
items.proposed_work: Add immutable preparation snapshots linked to a vial and the doses drawn from it.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Foundation for draw maths, exact stock and cost. Editing concentration must not rewrite past delivered mass.
items.implementation_scope: Preparation-records tranche: one immutable snapshot per vial; new injections link its ID. Optional attachment to unused legacy vials only; no invented legacy inputs. Re-preparation and revision audit remain deferred.
items.verification: Local focused checks; isolated PostgreSQL fresh migrations, rerunnable additive migration, preparation scope/immutability/concurrency tests and medication RLS matrix. Deployment is verified separately.

items.reference_capability: Tracks lot number, storage location, sealed expiry, opened and finished dates.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: expiry/opened/status fields exist. Lot/storage are not first-class fields in the inspected inventory.
items.proposed_work: Add lot and storage fields and expose a full stock history.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Preserve existing stock records and clearly separate expiry from prepared-use dates.
items.implementation_scope: Preparation-records tranche: editable lot number and storage location alongside existing lifecycle, opened date and sealed expiry. Complete lifecycle event history remains deferred.
items.verification: Local focused checks; isolated PostgreSQL fresh migrations, rerunnable additive migration, preparation scope/immutability/concurrency tests and medication RLS matrix. Deployment is verified separately.

items.reference_capability: Preparation override, peptide default, then a global fallback, with approaching/passed warnings.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: inventory form automatically derives opened date plus 28 days.
items.proposed_work: Replace the fixed UI default with product/preparation-specific, source-attributed dates.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Do not present a universal default as evidence of sterility or stability.
items.implementation_scope: Preparation-records tranche: explicit date or entered interval/base date/source, with no automatic 28-day fallback. Current vial metadata only; product/global defaults and BUD revision audit remain deferred.
items.verification: Local focused checks; isolated PostgreSQL fresh migrations, rerunnable additive migration, preparation scope/immutability/concurrency tests and medication RLS matrix. Deployment is verified separately.

items.reference_capability: Logs deduct actual delivered volume rather than one nominal dose.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: the existing inventory is primarily doses_total/doses_used based.
items.proposed_work: Deduct delivered mass/volume so changing dose size and partial draws give accurate remaining stock.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on I02/D03. Retain pen dose-count mode where appropriate.
items.implementation_scope: Existing linked delivered mass drives mass/volume balances; calibrated draws store delivered mass and volume. Variable-dose edits and deletion reconcile stock; incomplete legacy balances remain unknown. Count-based pen inventory retained. No generic stock/spill/priming adjustment ledger is authorised.
items.verification: Reconciled against existing edb6c85ec repository behavior and focused real PostgreSQL correction/deletion/concurrency checks; no new accounting feature added in this slice.

items.reference_capability: Walks future schedule slots, accounts for ramps, usable stock and lead times, and shows reorder dates.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: reorder flag and count threshold exist. No equivalent schedule-aware forecast found.
items.proposed_work: Calculate stock-out and order-by dates from actual planned demand, lead time and an explicit buffer.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on versioned schedules and exact stock. Surface unknown inputs and forecast horizon.

items.reference_capability: Projects next on-cycle demand as provisional and orders against planned restart.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: projected course-restart stock demand.
items.proposed_work: Extend forecasts to scheduled future courses and label unconfirmed restarts as provisional.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on P07/I06. Never represent provisional demand as a confirmed course.

items.reference_capability: Supply tiles, reorder list and needs-preparation group expose upcoming work.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: stock is available inside medication details.
items.proposed_work: Add a compact supplies view with next depletion, expiring preparations and stock needing preparation.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on I01–I06. No invented coverage if preparation or schedule is missing.

items.reference_capability: Order-level shipping, tax, fees and discounts allocate by value, quantity or none, with exact rounding.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: medication purchase/invoice accounting.
items.proposed_work: Add purchase headers and lines with explicit allocation and invoice-total reconciliation.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Foundation for cost features. Support GBP and retain original currency.

items.reference_capability: One invoice line can cover several vials; cost per vial does not depend on records already created.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: invoice-to-vial relationships.
items.proposed_work: Link each vial to a purchased line and divide landed line cost by purchased quantity.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on C01/I01. Validate purchased versus linked quantities.

items.reference_capability: Each logged dose is costed by delivered mass against landed vial cost, including dose ramps.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: per-dose medication cost calculation.
items.proposed_work: Derive dose and course cost from the actual mass used, preserving source invoice and preparation links.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on C01–C02/I05. Decide how later invoice corrections affect historic cost views.

items.reference_capability: Pack quantities and optional units per dose model needles, swabs, diluent and disposal cost.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: consumable cost model.
items.proposed_work: Add consumable lines and explicit usage assumptions, separately from peptide cost.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on C01. If usage is unknown, show spend instead of an invented per-dose burn rate.

items.reference_capability: Values residual mass in finished/discarded vials. Its waste display excludes vials with over 70% utilisation.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: discarded-stock valuation.
items.proposed_work: Report unused mass and cost on closure, with a configurable residue/waste reporting rule.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on I05/C03. Pitstop’s 70% filter is a product choice, not a universal accounting rule.

items.reference_capability: Missing invoices remain uncosted, prescription fallback avoids double counting, mixed currencies warn.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: medication cost completeness controls.
items.proposed_work: Show coverage and unknown costs; keep currencies separate unless an explicit dated FX policy is added.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on C01–C03. Missing price must never become zero cost.

items.reference_capability: By-peptide, monthly spend, sundries, waste and invoice views.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: medication spend dashboard.
items.proposed_work: Add monthly spend, cost per medicine/course, cost coverage and discarded value.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on C01–C06. Keep invoice cash spend distinct from consumed-product cost.

items.reference_capability: Protocol adherence, streaks, dose heatmaps and historical completion.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: shared adherence, perfect days, streaks and month calendar.
items.proposed_work: Retain Sparky’s calculations. Add long-window views only if useful.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Protocol versioning should strengthen historical accuracy.

items.reference_capability: Week rows show multiple slots and a month view opens daily detail.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: month calendar and daily log already exist.
items.proposed_work: Add a weekly timeline with planned and actual times, linked to existing calendar/day views.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on shared planned-slot data. Keep two daily doses visible as separate slots.

items.reference_capability: First-order elimination with instantaneous absorption; historic and planned curves are separated.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing and richer: absorption plus Tmax; local frontend also shows site/absorbed/total estimates.
items.proposed_work: Keep Sparky’s PK engine and current custom chart. Borrow clear history/forecast styling.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Neither model is a measured concentration. Do not replace Sparky’s absorption model with Pitstop’s simpler decay.

items.reference_capability: One graph can show each compound, including blend components with separate half-lives.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: custom per-medication GLP-1 profiles exist; equivalent combined component overlay not found.
items.proposed_work: Add a generic compound chart and overlay using Sparky’s existing absorption model where supported.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on compound identity/blends. Do not combine unlike units or imply modelled values are measured.

items.reference_capability: Labelled component masses split each blend dose; source can be label, CoA or assumed.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: composition-aware blend model.
items.proposed_work: Model preparation composition by stable compound ID and version the composition used by each dose.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Foundation for A04/A06. Do not merge different compounds just because names or families resemble each other.

items.reference_capability: Standalone and blend-delivered mass roll into one per-compound exposure ledger.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: injection history exists. Equivalent blend-aware exposure ledger not found.
items.proposed_work: Add delivered-mass totals by compound and time window, including derived blend contributions.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on A05 and canonical units. Delivered mass is not absorbed exposure or clinical AUC.

items.reference_capability: Compounds without half-lives are named below the chart instead of disappearing.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: custom profile settings exist. Equivalent per-compound omission list not found.
items.proposed_work: Show missing parameters, omitted compounds and data-history limits on the chart.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Retain existing custom chart labels and current 60-injection history limit until deliberately expanded.

items.reference_capability: Free text, weight, mood, energy, sleep, calories, protein and water.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: diary, mood, sleep, hydration and custom measurements are broader.
items.proposed_work: Retain existing records and add medication-event overlays rather than a second journal.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Sparky remains the main health record.

items.reference_capability: Custom symptoms and severity can link to doses and appear over time.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: symptom episodes, severity and medication links.
items.proposed_work: Keep the current symptom system and link new course/preparation identifiers when useful.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Avoid a peptide-only duplicate symptom history.

items.reference_capability: Dose-day sleep/HR/body-battery comparisons and symptom timing show sample sizes; minimum five per side.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing foundation: medication correlations and health reports.
items.proposed_work: Add transparent dose-day comparisons and lag views, with missing-data counts and sample coverage.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Descriptive associations only. Missing logs must not be interpreted as symptom-free days.

items.reference_capability: Curated/custom biomarkers, panels, reference ranges and marker trends.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: markers, per-result units/ranges, trends and reviewed AI report import.
items.proposed_work: Retain Sparky’s lab module and improve its comparison views.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Sparky already supports PDF/photo extraction with confirmation.

items.reference_capability: Biomarkers form rows and panel dates form columns, with in-range summaries.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: latest-marker cards and individual histories. Equivalent full panel matrix not found.
items.proposed_work: Add a marker-by-date matrix with filters, source ranges, units and threshold qualifiers visible.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Reuse existing labs. Do not numerically compare incompatible units or treat < and > as exact results.
items.implementation_scope: Read-only latest-three existing imported lab-report comparison in existing Labs, newest first; no invented manual-date panels. Stable marker/assay identity, stored units/ranges/qualifiers and only valid comparable exact-result trends are retained. Source unsafe qualifier stripping, cross-unit arrows and CRP merging are not copied. No arbitrary filters or date pickers.
items.verification: Focused web/mobile and shared/server checks, actual App desktop/narrow/light/dark visual checks, and independent pinned-source review passed. Latest-report SQL/route/middleware integration passed 3 cases on isolated PostgreSQL; existing RLS matrix passed 367. Deployment is verified separately.

items.reference_capability: Folds known biomarker names and spelling variants; keeps distinct assays separate at storage.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: marker catalog includes aliases and unit-aware plotting.
items.proposed_work: Extend alias coverage and collision checks where imports reveal gaps. Preserve separate assay identities.
items.dependencies_and_limits: No general unit conversion should occur from string normalisation alone.

items.reference_capability: Documents link to prescriptions, labs, scans and ECG records.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: lab extraction/import exists; documentation says the source report itself is not stored.
items.proposed_work: Optionally retain private source documents with links, retention settings and download controls.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Requires authenticated file access and deletion/backup rules. Pitstop bloodwork entry is not a universal lab-PDF parser.

items.reference_capability: Whole-body totals, eight regions, VAT, BMC/BMD and preparation conditions.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: generic body metrics and scale imports exist. No dedicated regional DEXA domain found.
items.proposed_work: Add structured scan records distinct from daily scales and BIA readings.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Store modality, scanner, units and source document. Preserve fat-free versus lean-soft-tissue definitions.

items.reference_capability: A specialised PDF parser pre-fills a review form for supported Hologic layouts.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: lab PDF/photo extraction exists, without this DEXA parser.
items.proposed_work: Start with manual scan entry, then add layout-specific reviewed PDF extraction.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on B01. Requires real report fixtures. Do not promise arbitrary scanner/PDF support.

items.reference_capability: Regional fat/lean/bone figure, change view and indices such as FFMI/ALMI.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: body measurements/progress views exist. Equivalent regional scan figure not found.
items.proposed_work: Add a regional scan table first and an optional body figure using the same stored values.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on B01. Regions, subtotal definitions and units need checks.

items.reference_capability: Device-specific precision/LSC bands and preparation checks qualify scan-to-scan changes.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: scanner-specific precision and DEXA comparability.
items.proposed_work: Show measured change alongside precision source and scanner/preparation comparability.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on B01. Defaults and clinical interpretation need independent evidence review.

items.reference_capability: Indirect-calorimetry results, VO2/VCO2/RQ, test conditions and predicted-equation comparison.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: BMR inputs and adaptive TDEE exist. No dedicated measured-RMR test history found.
items.proposed_work: Add dated measured-RMR results alongside estimated BMR/TDEE, with explicit model-selection controls.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Do not automatically replace calorie goals or confuse RMR, BMR and daily energy expenditure.

items.reference_capability: Life-event windows shade charts and exclude affected days from some comparisons.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: notes and custom metrics exist. Equivalent cross-chart interval annotations not found.
items.proposed_work: Add reusable illness/travel/context intervals with visible exclusion counts and a toggle.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Apply exclusions consistently and keep raw observations visible.

items.reference_capability: Scans link to dosing exposure, wearable/intake intervals, nearby bloodwork and completeness.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: underlying health data exists across modules. Equivalent scan-centred review not found.
items.proposed_work: Add an interval report joining scans, existing lab results, nutrition, training and compound totals.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on B01/A06/B06. Display data coverage and avoid attributing body changes to a compound.

items.reference_capability: Printable prep checklist and a suggested follow-up window.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: dedicated DEXA/RMR visit workflow.
items.proposed_work: Allow user/clinic-supplied prep notes and planned follow-up dates.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on B01/B05. Do not transplant fixed fasting or scan-cadence recommendations without review.

items.reference_capability: Steps, sleep, heart rate, HRV and related daily metrics sync via a sidecar.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: Garmin integration, sync and extensive generic health mapping.
items.proposed_work: Keep the current Garmin connection and import pipeline.
items.dependencies_and_limits: No reason to deploy a second Garmin sync service for these features.

items.reference_capability: Readiness, workload ratio, endurance/hill scores, fitness age and lactate threshold share a training card.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing mappings include readiness, endurance/hill scores, fitness age, load and lactate HR.
items.proposed_work: Add a coherent training/recovery view and join it to course annotations. Check remaining field gaps individually.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Garmin-reported readiness and Sparky-calculated readiness need distinct labels.

items.reference_capability: Separate-source sleep/stage/HRV/temperature rows, with a scheduled sidecar.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: Eight Sleep provider in inspected source.
items.proposed_work: Add only if the user has the device and wants the connection. Preserve source identity.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Unofficial API can break. Setup would need a separate authorised account-link task.

items.reference_capability: Paired nightly bars and averages only for overlapping nights; incompatible definitions are labelled.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: multiple provider sources and sleep analytics exist. Equivalent paired comparison not found.
items.proposed_work: Compare source-specific nightly metrics without averaging away disagreements or duplicate nights.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Can benefit current providers without Eight Sleep. Match wake-up dates/timezones and metric definitions.

items.reference_capability: Imports report classification, heart rate and waveform; displays the report’s findings.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: Withings ECG-related metrics exist. No Garmin PDF waveform importer found.
items.proposed_work: Add private ECG document records with report-provided classification and a trace viewer if needed.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Keep report findings verbatim. It would not diagnose or reclassify ECGs.

items.reference_capability: Installed-PWA Web Push supports per-slot reminders and an evening catch-up notice.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: mobile reminders and action categories exist. Equivalent server-originated web dose push not found.
items.proposed_work: Add optional browser subscriptions and per-slot web reminders while retaining native mobile reminders.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Avoid duplicate mobile/web reminders and keep payload detail user-configurable.

items.reference_capability: Optional Home Assistant webhook delivers reminders when no web subscription exists.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: medication-specific Home Assistant fallback.
items.proposed_work: Add an optional signed/scoped webhook transport using existing due-slot calculations.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on N03. No health details in default webhook or lock-screen payloads.

items.reference_capability: A unique send ledger coordinates per-slot/cycle reminders and retries.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: native notification IDs and reconciliation exist. No equivalent server delivery ledger found.
items.proposed_work: Record channel/slot delivery attempts with unique keys and retry status for web/HA transports.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Depends on P05. Define de-duplication behaviour across devices and transports.

items.reference_capability: Exports doses, labs, journal, wearable, DEXA and RMR datasets; blend mass is included where relevant.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: food, exercise, body/custom measurement exports exist. Equivalent peptide-complete set not found.
items.proposed_work: Extend exports to medication entries, preparation/stock/cost links and lab provenance.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Preserve qualifiers, dates, units, timezone and source IDs. A CSV is not a full restore backup.

items.reference_capability: Date-ranged dose, symptom/wellness and body-composition report with recent lab panels.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: report UI and weekly summaries exist. Equivalent consolidated PDF not found.
items.proposed_work: Create a selectable appointment report using existing medications, labs, measurements and symptom data.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Pitstop includes latest three labs outside the dose date range. Sparky should label section date scopes explicitly.

items.reference_capability: Aliases, category, route, half-life, storage notes and reference details.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: GLP-1 profiles, custom model inputs and broader medicine identifiers exist.
items.proposed_work: Separate compound identity/reference metadata from a patient’s medication and prescription.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Use authoritative references and source dates. Existing custom GLP-1 records should migrate without reclassification.

items.reference_capability: Seeded and refreshed peptidedosages.com reference data can pre-fill illustrative protocol/calculator inputs.
items.sparky_baseline: Not found: equivalent scraped peptide dosing templates.
items.proposed_work: Defer scraped dose templates. Build attributed reference metadata with explicit evidence quality first.
items.dependencies_and_limits: A third-party dosing site is not clinical validation. Retain manual authorisation of any schedule.

items.reference_capability: Responsive home-screen installation with light/dark themes and a motorsport visual system.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: responsive web/PWA and native mobile app with theming.
items.proposed_work: Retain Sparky’s design and navigation. Borrow focused supply/status layouts where useful.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Theme cloning offers less value than workflow improvements.

items.reference_capability: Provisioned local account, password plus TOTP, session cookies and sign out everywhere.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: Better Auth, SSO and passkey support with a broader multi-user model.
items.proposed_work: Retain existing authentication and family permissions when adding these domains.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Pitstop’s owner-first model is not a replacement for Sparky’s user-scoped access.

items.reference_capability: AES-256-GCM covers selected free text, lab values and scan fields. Not every numeric field is encrypted.
items.sparky_baseline: Partial: API-secret encryption exists; inspected lab values/notes are ordinary database fields.
items.proposed_work: Consider targeted health-field encryption with key recovery and explicit query/report trade-offs.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Architecture work, not a drop-in utility. Preserve indexing needs, RLS and backup/recovery.

items.reference_capability: SQLite/Litestream replication, Docker and optional Cloudflare Tunnel/Access.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing: Docker/PostgreSQL deployment and backup/restore facilities.
items.proposed_work: Keep the current deployment and backup stack. Cover new tables/files in backups and restore verification.
items.dependencies_and_limits: Litestream is SQLite-specific. Do not transplant Pitstop’s combined container or database.

items.reference_capability: Purpose-specific wearable import/export endpoints; retired HealthKit read-side endpoint returns 410.
items.sparky_baseline: Existing and broader: authenticated API and MCP tools.
items.proposed_work: Extend the existing API/MCP with read access to supply, cost, compounds and reports.
items.dependencies_and_limits: A Sparky implementation opportunity, not a claim that Pitstop has an equivalent MCP server.

workflow.gitHub_actions: workflow files removed from maintained branches
workflow.deployment: existing local build and release process
workflow.feature_scope: Verified Pitstop feature parity only; ask the owner before implementing features beyond the source application.
